scope: Lesson/controller/view only; frozen numerical runtime unchanged

findings.finding: A verified import could adopt after delayed old transport termination and overwrite a newer run
findings.fix: Check both lifecycle epoch and action/file epoch after awaited termination

findings.finding: Reset could restore default controls after a newer run started during old transport termination
findings.fix: Fence default restoration by lifecycle and action/file epochs

findings.finding: Restart awaited old termination before capturing ownership, so it could relabel a newer complete run idle or a hidden page dead
findings.fix: Capture clear epoch and action ticket before await; fence before/after ensure and rejection
findings.evidence: Independent delayed-termination audit and portable restart/run/pagehide regressions

findings.finding: A Worker factory/readiness wait had not yet entered pending requests and could leave the cancel control disabled
findings.fix: Track preparing submissions separately; cancellation clears preparing and pending state

findings.finding: A cancelled old read could clear a newer file selection
findings.fix: Clear only same-selection current successful adoption or current failed read; never clear a cancelled stale read
findings.evidence: Portable mounted stale-file-selection and same-file retry regressions

findings.finding: A delayed raw hash could finish after newer accepted data and deliver the old download
findings.fix: Fence export by captured lifecycle and exact result/imported identity; rejected candidates preserve the current result and export
findings.evidence: Independent lifecycle audit and portable delayed-digest regressions

findings.finding: A rejected delayed corrupt import could paint an obsolete error on a newer successful result
findings.fix: Stale import errors become cancelled terminals; UI action errors are fenced by lifecycle and action/file epochs
findings.evidence: Independent lifecycle audit and portable delayed-digest regressions

findings.finding: Controller could retain caller-owned input until Worker readiness
findings.fix: Validate and own bounded input synchronously before its first await

findings.finding: Codec integrity does not establish a valid numeric result structure
findings.fix: Do not render imported historical result bodies; explicit Worker replay is required

findings.finding: Nonnumeric custom covariance label shared communication-endpoint KKT wording
findings.fix: Custom Q is inapplicable to optimizer KKT table; no fake gradient/certificate or channel-eigenbasis label
findings.evidence: Independent audit and portable custom-Q view test

findings.finding: Blanket not-power caption was wrong for covariance diagonals, and 72 real-BFIM row ticks would overlap
findings.fix: Explicit raw-component versus modulus-square caption with power diagonals; thin large-matrix index ticks while retaining all data
findings.evidence: Static SVG-geometry review; actual-browser rendering remains unrun

findings.finding: First test receipt compared accepted final kernel to a provisional earlier hash
findings.fix: Reconcile test pin with accepted SOURCE-FREEZE; no runtime byte edited
findings.evidence: Preserved provisional log and final seven-file exact hash check

acceptance: Use final test and independent review receipts; this change log alone is not acceptance
